title: Nori hình thái 2 · tuyệt kỹ ném búa (sheet skill)
style: Static locked camera, three-quarter view facing screen-right, matching the reference, the whole body, weapon and shield always inside the frame with a margin, the face visible, the flat solid magenta background never changes. Clean anime game sprite animation, crisp lines. Hair, cloth, cape and loose pieces always keep moving with natural delay and follow-through, never frozen.

segments.name: A
segments.prompt: A chibi young knight with messy brown hair, small golden antlers with green leaves and green eyes, in silver plate armour with gold trim, a green scarf, a green leaf-pattern tabard and cape, a grey stone war hammer with gold bands and a green kite shield with a golden tree emblem strapped to his left forearm, from his guard stance raises the war hammer high overhead in his right hand alone, cocking it up and back to hurl it, knees bending, into the pose of the last frame. His left arm stays low in front of his body holding the shield the whole time; the left hand never touches the hammer. The hammer is ONE whole rigid weapon whenever he holds it. Feet adjust minimally between the supplied endpoint stances, staying grounded without sliding; no turning or scale change. Arms, shoulders and torso drive the action; hair, cloth and cape follow with natural overlapping motion. Preserve his identity, costume, proportions and the single shield, always drawn whole on his left forearm. No added effects, aura, glow, dust or particles.
